# Pinned import corpus

The original synthetic archives are distributed under the repository's
[Apache-2.0 license](../../../LICENSE). They contain no third-party mods or assets.
`manifest.json` pins their SHA-256 identities and independently authored expected
Modrinth output members. ZIP timestamps and Unix file attributes are fixed.

The corpus covers Modrinth side-specific overrides, CurseForge common overrides,
exact runtime selections, and traversal refusal. `journey_import` checks the hashes
before invoking the ordinary executable, preserves imported documents across two
syncs, and compares the complete exported content inventory and runtime metadata.
The fixture expectation is not derived from empack's importer or writer.

Run `python3 scripts/check-import-corpus.py` from the repository root. It uses the
shared verification runner, including executable identity and result receipts.
This local corpus needs no network, Java, or provider credentials. It does not
qualify external provider behavior or real launcher/game consumption.

Changes to archives or expected output require deliberate review of both the
source contents and expectations. The checker never refreshes them. Moving
upstream packs belong to `scripts/survey-imports.py`; survey observations cannot
replace these pinned expectations.

## Pinned upstream pack

`fabulously-optimized-6.5.0.json` records Fabulously Optimized 6.5.0,
Modrinth project `1KVo5zza`, version `N276l2ON`. The archive is 177,589 bytes.
Its SHA-512 matches the version record; SHA-256 and the override inventories were
computed independently with Python's ZIP reader, without empack. No upstream
archive, mod, resource pack or configuration bytes are committed here.

The expectation retains all 50 declared files (44,322,932 bytes), ordered download
fallbacks, hashes, sizes and side requirements, plus hashes and sizes for all 63
overrides. The source index declares every file required on both sides; project
catalog labels do not override those declarations. The runtime is Minecraft
1.21.1 with Fabric loader 0.19.3. All payload members are ordinary `overrides/`
files, including the opaque `resourcepacks/Mod Menu Helper.zip`; there are no
optional files, auxiliary payloads or side-specific exclusions in this pack.
The synthetic and controlled fixtures cover those other decisions.

Run `python3 scripts/verify.py pinned-import`. This ignored live suite downloads
the exact archive into a disposable workspace, checks both archive digests before
import, and uses fresh isolated state/cache paths. It checks two-sync convergence,
the complete Modrinth export and all acquired bytes in a bundled Prism export.
Imported overrides are locked local dependencies. After an edit, sync must refuse
and preserve the prior lock/artifacts; explicit adoption accepts the changed bytes.
Without a version bump, the next Modrinth export must contain that edit while
preserving the earlier bundled artifact and author metadata.
Only the two generated launcher metadata files may exist outside the expected
game inventory. No Java or launcher is executed. Network failure fails the
attempt; the test does not select a newer version or retry the whole journey.

Archive acquisition has a 60-second deadline and reads at most the declared size
plus one byte. Each CLI command has a 600-second deadline. Output inspection
limits each member to 16 MiB and the bundled archive to 64 MiB decoded/255 entries.
All downloaded and generated bytes are temporary; receipts retain source/test
identity and outcomes rather than republishing the pack.

The pack's [pinned license](https://github.com/Fabulously-Optimized/fabulously-optimized/blob/a20d4bf2ab7f7be8741aaeca2211ef1899c6e8ed/LICENSE.md)
is BSD-3-Clause, copyright Fabulously Optimized Authors. Referenced mods retain
their own licenses; this is not permission to redistribute every component.
Fixture revisions require reviewing the upstream archive and expectations anew.
There is no automatic golden update. This one pack does not qualify CurseForge,
restricted downloads, launcher import/startup, or the full UX-017 group.
